title: Early-Payment Discount Rate for Units Bought on Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreements — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
On a Service Accounts and Repair Orders fleet invoice, the discount rate follows how the invoice's unit was bought, as the Vehicle Purchase Agreements records show, and the terms:

| Invoice's unit bought under a Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement | Account | Discount rate |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Commercial Fleet Account - Net 30 | 2.5% |
| Yes | Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15 | 1.5% |
| Otherwise | — | the tier's early-payment discount share; no change applies |

**Terms.** The unit is the vehicle on the invoice's labor charges. It was bought under a Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement when a purchase deal for that vehicle on the Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement stands closed; a deal of another kind, or one not closed, does not count.

**Hypothetical.** A Net 30 invoice for a unit bought on a closed Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement deal, discountable total 1500.00: at 2.5%, 37.50 before any other term of the discount.
